# Applications open for [DuQuantum 2026!](https://www.duquantum.org)
DuQuantum is the first annual quantum computing hackathon at Duke. 
We invite quantum enthusiasts to tackle challenges designed by industry leaders and gain experience with state-of-the-art quantum tools.
All undergrad, Master's and PhD students are eligible.
Mailing list [here](https://duke.is/duquantum-mailing-list).

::: {style="text-align: center;"}
# APPLY [<strong>HERE</strong>](https://duke.is/duquantum-application-2026)
:::


---

## About Me
I'm an undergrad at [Duke University](https://www.duke.edu) studying Physics and Mathematics, with a minor in Statistical Science. 
I’m interested in scientific machine learning theory/methods from a (stochastic) dynamics and geometry perspective. 
Specifics include

  + Theory: mathematical foundations of generative modeling, transformers
  + Methods: learning dynamics, physics-informed techniques
  + Applications: microbiology, materials, quantum chemistry

Recently I've become interested in quantum information and learning. 
I was born in Beijing, China. My given name is Xiran; I go by Derek. 

I've put some notes and other stuff I've written [here](notes.html), mainly for my own reference. 


## Experience
As part of the [Lingchong You Lab](https://www.youlab.bio/), I work on ML for time-series parameter estimation and forecasting
for bacterial growth.

In Summer 2026, I was a research intern at [Oak Ridge National Lab](https://www.ornl.gov/) mentored by
[Stephan Irle](https://www.ornl.gov/staff-profile/stephan-irle) and [Max Lupo Pasini](https://www.ornl.gov/staff-profile/massimiliano-lupo-pasini). 
Here I used GNNs to learn electron densities of drug-like molecules.

In Summer 2025, I was an AI R&D intern at [Lenovo](https://www.lenovo.com/us/en/) with the 
[Cloud Service Providers](https://www.lenovo.com/us/en/servers-storage/solutions/cloud-service-provider/), where I assembled
an AI cluster testbed and looked at network optimization schemes.

Throughout the 2025-26 school year, as part of the [Liberata](https://liberata.info/) Algorithms Team, I developed graph- and embedding-based algorithms
for a new academic publishing system based on continuous authorship shares.


## Involvements

I'm a co-lead organizer of the new [DuQuantum](https://duquantum.org/) quantum computing hackathon at Duke. This is a collaboration
between the Duke Quantum Information Society ([DuQIS](https://www.dukeqis.org/)) and [HackDuke](https://hackduke.org/).

I lead the Research Committee for the Statistical Science Majors Union (SSMU), where I organize a 
seminar series and reading group on theory/methods in modern statistics. More [here](ssmu.html).

I'm also a part of the Math Community Team in the Duke Math Department, where I help run undergrad activities, including a mini-colloquium series. 
I made some custom math board/party games [here](math-games.html). I also serve as an Event Coordinator for the Society of Physics Students.

I'm a graphic designer of 8+ years. Lately I use Figma. 
I served as a co-director of [HackDuke](https://hackduke.org/) in 2025-2026, where I led the Design Team. 
I also design for the Duke Math Union, in particular the annual [Duke Math Meet](https://dukemathmeet.org/). See some past works [here](design.html).

See some photos [here](photos.html).
